sourceInformation.genre: Sports (fitness and balance minigame collection in a light life-sim week)
sourceInformation.perspective: Isometric on the island; fixed front-on for class activities; fixed side/top views per activity
sourceInformation.tech: Pixel Engine 0.46.0 (three.js r186, Rapier 0.20 bundled), esbuild single-file bundle, AI Hub Session Protocol v1 client 1.4.0
sourceInformation.artDirection: Engine native pixel look, 16-colour palette, white tile plaza on a pastel island of giant gym equipment
sourceInformation.animation: Engine ClipDef data with AnimationMixer; procedural lean layer from the Dot
sourceInformation.audio: Engine Song and SoundDef data, all written in code; Web Audio formant Animalese voices; music at 10% by default
sourceInformation.online: AI Hub ghost mode 1-4 players with own card; Family Hour local 1-4 on one screen; no other network use
sourceInformation.testing: Headless Node tests plus Playwright browser checks on this computer (WebGPU Chromium; gamepad/touch/analyser stand-ins). See Testing Feedback.
sourceInformation.research: Director plan included engine and hub research and verified spikes (PLAN sections 4, 17); builder read GUIDE.md, ASSETS.md and hub README.md whole and searched API.md/LIBRARY.md.

testingFeedback: Testing caught 3 issues: 2 song pattern step-count mismatches and a short line bank, all fixed. Final headless run: 230/230 passed.
Critical / game-breaking: 0 in the final run. Earlier harness 404 was a test-server path bug, not a game bug.
Most helpful: the headless activity runs and Dot bot table, which check balance, scoring and finishing without a browser.
Least helpful: screenshot-only checks, which confirm composition but not timing or scoring.
engineFeedback: Liked most: the single-file engine with headless mode, recording/replay and the pixel HUD, which make scripted testing practical.
Stuck or guessed wrong: see final report; hub card timing and song step-clock details needed care.
Most important thing built on top: the Dot balance simulation with bot drivers shared by play, classmates, attract mode and tests.
Hardest part: fitting a 7-day week, ten activity kinds, lanes and hub ghosts into one HUD-driven architecture without dense screens.
Changed in the engine: none. pixel-engine.js is byte-identical (sha256 recorded in vendor/pixel-engine.sha256).
One change wished for: documented song step clock and audio bus access for voice routing (both are present but undocumented in 0.46.0).
promptFeedback: Liked most: the plan’s verified numbers (Dot defaults, bot table, camera framings) remove guesswork where feel matters most.
Confusing: the scope is very large for one build; the cut list in PLAN section 19 is essential.
Hardest thing: the hub ghost protocol plus the full week plus ten activities in a single file.
Change: split the build order into separately shippable stages with their own acceptance checks.

aiHub.name: Fit Getaway
aiHub.description: A polite fitness comedy on Tare Island. Lean the Dot, hold poses, chase stars, and be judged, kindly, by Ounce the scale.
aiHub.controls: Left stick, WASD or mouse: lean. R2, Space or click: breathe. L1/R1, F/J or mouse buttons: step.
